newsitem.title: PERU: Peruvian 74-year old killed in birthday bullfight.
newsitem.headline: Peruvian 74-year old killed in birthday bullfight.

text.p: A Peruvian pensioner died trying to show off his skills as a bullfighter during his 74th birthday party, local media reported Friday.
Marco Padilla, from the northern town of Acushpampa, dragged friends away from a barbecue held in his honour and invited them to watch him take on a bull in a nearby stable.
But the manly display did not last long as Padilla failed to avoid one of the bull's advances and was skewered by the animal's horns.
Friends killed the bull and sold the meat to raise money for his funeral.
